rules: Every transition checks expected version and emits audit/outbox atomically.
Approval consumption is a separate immutable ledger entry, not a resettable approval state.
Unknown outcome resolution requires reconciler evidence and authorized decision.
Retry creates a new attempt; no terminal attempt returns to running.

transitionGuards.job.running->queued: Only a classified retryable failed attempt with no unresolved effect, bounded attempts/deadline, backoff and fresh admission; never reverse a terminal attempt.
transitionGuards.job.blocked->queued: Explicit recovery reason; all effect guards reconciled and policy allows reexecution; otherwise resume verification instead of rerunning effects.
transitionGuards.job.outcome_unknown->terminal: Target-specific reconciliation evidence plus accepted verifier/authorized resolution; no generic retry.
transitionGuards.approval.pending->approved: Current authenticated human/step-up, exact displayed digest, separation of duties and unexpired current version.
transitionGuards.evidence.submitted->verified: Pinned independent evaluator, immutable bytes, all required criteria and external effects accepted.

notes.job.outcome_unknown+verifying,queued: re-admission after reconciliation: applied effect re-enters verification, proven-absent effect re-queues for a fresh attempt (reconcile.apply)
notes.attempt.outcome_unknown+verifying: the same attempt's re-admission when reconciliation proves the effect applied
notes.workflow.suspended+failed: a rejected gate step fails its suspended run; engine.resume drives this
notes.attempt.running+verifying: runner completion starts evidence assembly without an intermediate upload-report step; uploading remains the optional path for runners that report upload progress
